weather_report:
Perth slides past noon with the sun shouldering its way into a bright, open afternoon. Skies are set to turn clean and clear by early afternoon, a polished blue that invites a squint, then soften toward late day with a scattering of friendly clouds. Expect strong sunshine and a punchy UV index through mid-afternoon; clarity will be high, edges crisp, shadows inky. As the light mellows later, the day should remain pleasant, the horizon a little gauzy but still generous.

Dress light and breathable, add a brimmed hat and sunglasses, and give your skin a careful coat of sunscreen; tuck a light layer in your bag for the cooler, cloud-streaked late afternoon. It’s a good day for ordinary pleasures: take a shaded lunch on a verandah, air out the house, hang the washing and let the sun do the work, amble to the shops on foot, or tend to a bit of garden fussing. As the clouds gather toward evening, a gentle stroll along the river or a bench with a book will feel just right.
